d2m1-cov.hook: Send each bill to **the right first payer**, or it comes back as a lien
points: Sort every coverage: **whose it is**, and what it pays
Only BI and UM are **the $40,000 Recovery Stack**
Payer-First: **PIP, then Peach State**, an LOP last
Verify PIP and UM in writing; **never assume either**
d2m1-cov.upl: Route bills in the default order; primacy and lien enforceability are Atty. Thorne's
dos: Verify every coverage in writing: **a dated Declaration Page**
Confirm the Health Plan was **active on the loss date**
Keep the Payer Order and **the Recovery Stack apart**
donts: An LOP to a provider **PIP would have paid**
PIP, PD or collision **added to the stack**
Assuming PIP, or **UM on the client's own policy**

ruleEx.rule: **BI is exhausted first** (paid or tendered at limits); Host UM opens next, and Relative UM stacks behind it
ruleEx.exception: Settling or releasing BI **without the UM carriers' written consent** can forfeit the stack
ruleEx.onFile: Consent comes first, on Atty. Thorne's authority
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne confirms each policy's terms

redFlag.costs: PIP was added: PIP pays bills, not the claim, so every figure built on it is wrong
redFlag.do: Rebuild it: **BI $10,000, Host UM $20,000, Relative UM $10,000**

roadmap.title: Three Carriers, One Day: the Roadmap

steps.label: Draft on template
steps.text: One LOR per carrier, **each naming its own insured**

steps.label: Request and preserve
steps.text: Limits, Dec Pages, photos, video and vehicle data

steps.label: Protect the client
steps.text: Third-party letter: his name only, nothing more

steps.label: Send and log
steps.text: Each carrier's preferred method; Atty. Thorne signs

steps.label: Follow up
steps.text: No acknowledgement by **the third business day**: call

d2m1-l1.hook: The LOR moves every carrier onto the firm; one wrong letter risks **$30,000 of UM coverage**.
d2m1-l1.whyLine: One wrong Letter of Representation risks **$30,000 of UM coverage**.
points: Name the **right insured** on each: Robert Smith, Kevin Alvarez, Margaret Doe
Notify **all three stack carriers** now: late notice hands them a defense
**Notice, not demand**: no UM payment request before the documented BI tender
Keystone gets **John Doe's name only**: no phone, address, birth date, employer
d2m1-l1.upl: You draft and send; Atty. Thorne signs. Never value the claim or argue fault.
dos: Confirm **claim number and adjuster** on every claim call
Keep claim-opening facts **general and verifiable**
Treat other coverage as **a question for Atty. Thorne**
donts: A UM letter that **reads as a demand**
The client's **phone, address or birth date** to Keystone
A **guessed adjuster name** for Cardinal State

redFlag.see: A UM notice letter that **asks for payment** before any BI tender
redFlag.costs: Notice is not demand: a premature UM demand puts $30,000 of the stack at risk
redFlag.do: Send notice only; **payment requests wait** for the documented BI tender

d2m1-a1.situation: File date 02/17/2026. Claims are open with Keystone (BI and PD), Harbor Point (Host UM, PIP) and Cardinal State, **no adjuster assigned**. **Five letters** must go out today.
steps: In CMS → Documents → Outgoing, draft the five letters on the firm template: three letters of representation and **two notices**.
Give each letter its Attn line, insured, claim, policy or member number and date of loss, and ask for limits, Declaration Pages and preservation.
Route the set to Atty. Thorne for signature, then send each letter by the carrier's preferred method.
Calendar a check for each acknowledgement on the CMS Calendar.
d2m1-a1.deliver: Five letters **signed, sent and logged**, each correctly addressed, follow-ups calendared
d2m1-a1.purpose: One wrong letter risks **the UM coverage** or hands Keystone his private details
d2m1-a1.principle: Every letter is notice, **never a demand**, and counsel signs it
checks: Cardinal State: **“Attn: Claims Department”**, not a guessed name
**Correct insured** on each: Robert Smith, Kevin Alvarez, Margaret Doe
Keystone: **John Doe's name only**; PD carve-out for the Civic
No UM letter **asks for payment**
All signed and sent 02/17/2026; **follow-up 02/20/2026** if silent
dos: Read each letter **against the claim-call log** before signature
Tell John Doe: PD may call **about the Civic only**
donts: One letter copied five times, **insured left as Robert Smith**
**Sending before signature** because a carrier said “today”

d2m1-l2.hook: An unverified coverage fact is a guess: put **a source behind every “confirmed”**.
points: Limits stay **preliminary until a Declaration Page** or Coverage Letter
Get each UM carrier's form **in writing**: add-on or reduced
Stack **three layers to $40,000**; PIP and PD are tracked, never added
Every open item carries **a dated next follow-up**
d2m1-l2.upl: You record and chase; applying terms or alleging bad faith is Atty. Thorne's call.
dos: Log a verbal limit at once, **marked verbal**
Keep **a paper trail** on every Keystone request
Check each policy period **covers 02/06/2026**
donts: **Adding PIP or PD** to the stack total
Confirming a limit **from a phone call** or Police Report
An open request with **no next date**

redFlag.see: The matrix on **03/11/2026** reads 'BI: Confirmed · Police Report'
redFlag.costs: A Police Report, a phone call or the client's memory is a lead, never a limit
redFlag.do: Mark BI 'Disclosed', **request the Dec Page** in writing, docket the follow-up

d2m1-a2.situation: File date 03/11/2026. A colleague's Coverage Matrix **totals $45,000**. The file holds Harbor Point's 03/02/2026 confirmation, Cardinal State's 03/09/2026 letter and **no Keystone Declaration Page** yet.
steps: In CMS → Insurance → Coverage Matrix, check every row against its document and correct each error, citing the **document and date** that prove it.
Bring the stack total back to $40,000 and leave the correct rows alone.
For each past-due follow-up, take the action now and set a new date. Take the adjuster's call below if it comes.
Route a three-line audit note to Atty. Thorne: what is confirmed in writing, what is still preliminary, and what you escalated.
d2m1-a2.deliver: A corrected matrix **totalling $40,000**, every status sourced, open items dated, note routed
d2m1-a2.purpose: Every later decision reads this matrix: **one unsourced cell** misstates the $40,000 stack
d2m1-a2.principle: Nothing is confirmed **without a document behind it**
checks: BI: **still preliminary**; Declaration Page not until 03/20/2026
**PIP out** of the stack: it pays bills, not claims
Stack total **$45,000 corrected to $40,000**
BI follow-up **logged 03/11/2026**; next by 03/13/2026
Bluewater's “UM: none” chased: **signed rejection form** (03/14/2024)
dos: Open the letter **before you change the cell**
donts: **Marking BI confirmed** because $10,000 is expected
Fixing the total **without finding why**

questions: Name every coverage, whose it is and what it pays. Which **three are the $40,000 stack**?
Give each layer of the **Policy Stack** you built in the CMS: carrier, claim, limit, party, order.
Name the **five letters** sent 02/17/2026: for each, the insured named and how it was addressed.

d2m2-l1.hook: An LOP **out of Payer Order** turns a payable bill into a lien on his net.
points: Run the Payer Order: **PIP → Peach State → LOP**
Use an LOP **only where earlier payers can't**
Atty. Thorne sets LOP terms; **never promise payment** amounts, reductions or dates
Be the hub: **warm handoffs**, not phone numbers
d2m2-l1.upl: You prepare and route LOPs; never set terms, sign, promise payment or explain liability.
dos: Ask **“Is the plan working?”** at every contact
Tell John Doe **which payer handles which bill**
Reconcile **conflicting provider statements** at once
donts: An LOP **before checking PIP** and Peach State
Telling a provider **“paid in full at settlement”**
Mission creep: taking on **every problem John Doe raises**

redFlag.see: A provider wants your word they'll be **paid in full** at settlement
redFlag.costs: It's a promise you can't make: the LOP's terms are Atty. Thorne's
redFlag.do: Promise no amount, reduction or date; **route terms to Atty. Thorne**

d2m2-eob.hook: Every bill's story is in **the EOB and the PIP ledger**: read them before you answer
points: Read billed, allowed, **write-off, paid**, member share, in order
Member responsibility is **the most a provider may bill**
A plan's lien starts at **what it paid**, never billed
PIP paid **$5,000.00 in five checks**; exhausted 06/26/2026
d2m2-eob.upl: Read and report what payers paid; whether a balance is owed is Atty. Thorne's
dos: Read every EOB to **the member-responsibility line**
Keep billed and paid **on the same CMS line**
Tell John Doe **what you are doing** about a bill
donts: A lien logged **at the billed amount**
A contractual write-off treated as **the client's debt**
A bill sent to PIP **after 06/26/2026**

ruleEx.rule: A plan's reimbursement claim is **what it paid, never what was billed**
ruleEx.exception: Crescent's 07/01/2026 statement for $1,540.00 is **a balance bill**: route it to Atty. Thorne the same day
ruleEx.onFile: Peach State EOB 06/03/2026: billed $3,400.00, plan paid $1,860.00
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne handles the balance bill

redFlag.see: A lien logged **at the billed amount**, or a bill sent to PIP after 06/26/2026
redFlag.costs: The lien is overstated by the contractual adjustment, or the bill goes to an exhausted payer
redFlag.do: Log the plan-paid **$1,860.00**; check PIP's balance before routing any bill

d2m2-a1.situation: 02/23/2026. Urgent care's $685.00 went to PIP. Riverton Spine & Rehab, **out of network** for Peach State, starts care 02/24/2026. On 03/11/2026 Summit Imaging asks for **an LOP for the MRI**.
steps: Run the Payer Order for each provider and record the result in the CMS.
Prepare Riverton Spine & Rehab's LOP on the approved template, route it to Atty. Thorne for signature, and send it with the **HIPAA authorization**.
Take the call below with Tammy Greer: confirm the clinic accepts the LOP and secure the 02/24/2026 appointment, promising no payment.
Write the call up as a dated Case Note, open the follow-up tasks, and file the LOP and the note in the CMS.
On 03/11/2026, decline Summit's request in writing, naming Harbor Point PIP as the payer.
d2m2-a1.deliver: One **counsel-approved LOP** sent and endorsed by call, one declined, all logged
d2m2-a1.purpose: A needless LOP makes **a bill PIP would pay** a lien on his recovery
d2m2-a1.principle: **An LOP comes last**, after PIP and Peach State
checks: Signed by John Doe and Atty. Thorne **before 02/24/2026**
Baseline: 2021 visits **low back, resolved**; no prior neck
Rental end 03/19/2026 calendared: after it, **out of pocket**
Decline proved: **$3,675.00 left**, enough for the $2,395.00 MRI
Call logged and tasked; **no payment promised** to any provider
dos: Run the Payer Order **before the LOP template**, every time
Highlight prior history: **never hide it**
donts: An LOP to a provider **PIP would have paid**
Answering **“paid in full?”** beyond the LOP's terms

steps.label: Check in
steps.text: Visits, pain, function, and **any barrier**

steps.label: Name the variance
steps.text: Clinical, psychosocial or systemic

steps.label: Assess
steps.text: Medical danger to the provider; legal danger to Atty. Thorne

steps.label: Coordinate
steps.text: Clarify with the office; **remove the barrier**

steps.label: Track
steps.text: Every fix attempt in a GIRP note, facts only

d2m2-l2.hook: On an LOP, you are **the only real-time check** that John Doe's plan is working.
points: Monitor **outcomes, not attendance** alone; hunt the barriers
Week 6 (04/07/2026): **20–30% more range of motion** or lower pain
**A-C-T every red flag**; write each intervention as a GIRP note
Adjust the plan first; **climb one documented rung** at a time
d2m2-l2.upl: You coordinate care, never direct it, and never tie missed visits to claim value.
dos: Raise **two or more missed visits** with the provider
**Proofread laterality**: everything on this file is right-sided
Record the disruption **the day it happens**
donts: **Continuing the plan unchanged** through a crisis
**Blaming the client** for a systemic delay
Jumping to Atty. Thorne **before the first two rungs**

ruleEx.rule: **A-C-T for every red flag**, the same day
ruleEx.exception: A silent client can't be assessed until reached: **Assess runs through the No Contact Protocol**
ruleEx.onFile: Silence is a symptom, not non-compliance
ruleEx.confirm: Legal danger goes to Atty. Thorne

redFlag.see: The plan run **unchanged through a crisis**, or a label put on John
redFlag.costs: Care stalls, and your note carries a diagnosis no doctor made
redFlag.do: Document his distress **in his own words**; adjust the plan with consent

d2m2-a2.situation: 04/08/2026: John Doe missed 04/03 and 04/07 and **answers no one**; last visit 04/02/2026. Notices go unanswered until he calls on **04/17, three days before** the letter's date.
steps: Do the Step 1 review, then send notices on an escalating channel and log each one in the CMS Communications Log.
Escalate to Atty. Thorne and send the 10-day Final Warning Letter by certified mail and by email.
Take John's call below on 04/17: listen, record **his own words**, and give no diagnosis or advice.
With his consent, book Dr. Reyes and the evening visits on the CMS Calendar, then restore the file's status and confirm 04/21 and 04/23.
d2m2-a2.deliver: A near-drop record: notices, the letter, **his words**, the file restored
d2m2-a2.purpose: **Silence is a symptom**: find the cause before anyone calls it non-compliance
d2m2-a2.principle: Record his words; **never diagnose, advise or value**
checks: Notices by channel: **04/08, 04/09, 04/10**, each logged
Letter by **certified mail AND email**, respond by 04/20/2026
His words quoted; **no label, no counseling advice**
**Drop Warning cleared** 04/20; 14-day trigger reset
dos: Lead with **“I'm glad you called”**, not the deadline
Escalate **by channel, not volume**
donts: Telling him **“that sounds like PTSD”**
Passing **what he told you** to his providers

d2m2-a3.situation: Assuming John Doe has **refused Millbrook** and Crescent Pain & Spine is booked for 05/15/2026, the follow-up tasks still need logging.
steps: Log it in the CMS: cancel the Millbrook slot on the Calendar, add Crescent under Parties, and open one task for each follow-up with **an owner and a due date**.
Write a short Case Note for Atty. Thorne saying what changed and why, with no medical advice.
d2m2-a3.deliver: A CMS task list: every task **Done by me** or Delegated, owner and date
d2m2-a3.purpose: A referral he won't attend **opens a new Treatment Gap** in his care
d2m2-a3.principle: **The facility is his choice**; the care is his doctors'
checks: Crescent **verified in network** with Peach State, not hearsay
Crescent's 05/15/2026 slot: **no new Treatment Gap**
Millbrook cancelled; **calendar and reminders** updated
Records request **delegated with an owner** and due date
**No medical advice**; no talk of claim value
dos: Read **Dr. Reyes's referral note** before you call anyone
Give every open task **an owner and a date**
donts: Telling John Doe **which facility is better** medically
Repeating **what John heard** about the network, unverified

questions: Read Peach State's 06/03/2026 EOB line by line. What does **each amount** mean for the file?
Crescent bills John Doe $1,540.00 on 07/01/2026. **What do you do**, and what do you tell him?
Using **the Payer Order**, explain Riverton's LOP and Summit's decline, and what you may tell each provider.

steps.label: Plan the questions
steps.text: Read the records; write questions, **never expected answers**

steps.label: Open on the record
steps.text: Date, participants, your role, his consent, privacy

steps.label: Ask open, follow his words
steps.text: Broad first, his words next, closed questions last

steps.label: Ask for the paper
steps.text: Work schedules, doctor notes, travel logs, **illness records**

steps.label: Read it back
steps.text: He corrects your summary; opinion questions routed

steps.label: Record and task
steps.text: His words as given; a dated task per document

d2m3-l1.hook: The gap explanation that holds up is **John Doe's own**, backed by documents.
points: Investigate, don't advocate: write **questions only**, never expected answers
Funnel: **open first**, closed questions last, one at a time
**Never lead**: a suggested reason gets agreement, not information
Record **only with his spoken consent**; protect privilege
d2m3-l1.upl: Never say what the gap does to his case; route that to Atty. Thorne.
dos: **Ask open**, follow his words, close last
Paraphrase back and **let him correct you**
**Prevent the next gap** now; it's cheaper than explaining it
donts: A question that **names the reason** you expect
Reassuring or alarming him: **both are case opinions**
**Blaming the client** for the gap

ruleEx.rule: John's recorded account **to his own firm**, with consent, stays inside the firm
ruleEx.exception: **Keystone asks for a Recorded Statement**: he declines and refers it to the firm
ruleEx.onFile: Harbor Point or Cardinal State requests fall under cooperation clauses
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne handles first-party carrier requests

redFlag.see: A leading question: **'Was it because you had no car?'**
redFlag.costs: It buys agreement, not information, and the account stops being his
redFlag.do: Ask open: 'What got in the way?' Then **log his exact words**

d2m3-a1.situation: 03/04/2026. EMS recorded neck stiffness on 02/06/2026; urgent care on 02/20/2026 noted **onset at the MVA** and right-hand numbness since 02/18. Nobody has asked **why he waited 14 days**.
steps: Take the recorded call below. Open on the record: the date, who is on the call, his **consent to recording**, and that he can talk privately.
Ask open questions first, and use closed questions only to pin down dates and documents. Ask who he told and what he kept.
Read his account back to him and restate the standing instruction.
File a privileged GIRP note in CMS → Case Notes the same day.
d2m3-a1.deliver: **All four reasons**, in his words, on a consented, privileged recording; GIRP note filed
d2m3-a1.purpose: A suggested reason proves nothing: **only his own words**, backed by documents, hold up
d2m3-a1.principle: **Investigate, don't advocate**: never put a reason in his mouth
checks: **Zero leading questions**; no reason introduced first
**Four reasons in his words**: transport, soreness, coverage, numbness
Corroboration: texts, **02/09–02/13 call-outs**, 02/07/2026 receipt
**No opinion** on what the gap does
GIRP note **filed 03/04/2026**, labelled privileged
dos: **Let a pause run**; silence draws out detail
Put his words **in quotation marks**
donts: **Rescuing a hesitant client** with a suggested reason
Ending the call without asking **who he told**

d2m3-l2.hook: Records made at the time prove continuity; **a record made to order** destroys the case.
points: Read every history for **mechanism, onset and body region**
**Never request** a change, back-date or excuse note to order
Flag conflicting histories **to Atty. Thorne**; never resolve them yourself
Never hide an interruption: **show its dates**, same complaints before and after
d2m3-l2.upl: You collect, compare and flag; never tell a provider what to write.
dos: Collect **what already exists** before asking for anything new
**Quote records exactly**; never strengthen a history
Keep **every interruption visible** on the timeline
donts: A “clarify” request that **tells them what to write**
**Leaving the gap out** of the timeline

ruleEx.rule: Continuity is proved by **records made at the time**, then by a treating doctor's opinion
ruleEx.exception: A record wrong at its source is corrected by **its author's dated addendum**; the original stays
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne approves any correction request

redFlag.see: A request to a provider to **change, back-date or add** to a record
redFlag.costs: An altered record undercuts every record around it
redFlag.do: Request only **the author's dated addendum**; never order an excuse note

d2m3-cause.hook: Proving negligence is **only half the battle**: prove the collision caused the harm.
points: Fault proves negligence; **causation and damages** must be proved too
A medical professional writes it, to **reasonable medical probability**
Atty. Thorne requests it; you **assemble, track and check**
Check it against the file: **date of loss, level, visits**
d2m3-cause.upl: You request, track, check and file; **never draft or coach** the opinion

document.name: Causation Letter
document.definition: A formal letter: a **medical professional's opinion** linking the accident to the specific injuries, from a treating physician, surgeon or independent medical expert.
document.purpose: Proves the half negligence can't: that the defendant's conduct **directly caused** the specific harm, medical expenses and ongoing limitations claimed.
document.evidence: Its opinions, held more likely than not, tie the C5-C6 herniation to 02/06/2026 and **answer the 14-Day Gap** and 2021 visits.
handling: Atty. Thorne requests it; you **assemble the record set** and docket follow-up
On arrival, **check it against the file**: date of loss, level, visits
File it under Medical; **cite it** on the Gap Explanation Record
**Never draft or coach** the opinion; what it means stays Atty. Thorne's

dos: Send the doctor **the complete record set**, priors included
Read the letter **against the file** the day it arrives
Check every injury claimed has **a medical link**
donts: Suggesting or **shaping the doctor's words**
Leaving **the 2021 records** out of the set
Telling John Doe the letter **raises his claim's value**

redFlag.see: **'Possibly'** or 'could be' in the Causation Letter's opinion
redFlag.costs: It falls short of 'more likely than not'
redFlag.do: Flag it to Atty. Thorne; **never ask the doctor** to strengthen it

d2m3-a2.situation: 06/22/2026. MMI 06/12/2026; Dr. Reyes's **06/19/2026 Causation Letter**, her 04/20 note and the counseling summary are in. Atty. Thorne wants **the Gap Explanation Record** before the pre-demand session.
steps: In CMS → Case File → Gap Explanation Record, cover both the 14-day gap and the **19-day disruption**, with exact dates.
Put each reason beside the dated document that proves it, and mark a reason with no document as account only.
Read it as the defense would, fix anything that argues or values the claim, then route it to Atty. Thorne.
File the non-economic damages records in the CMS so they are backed up to your Drive.
d2m3-a2.deliver: A routed record of **both interruptions**, every reason beside a dated document
d2m3-a2.purpose: The defense will test every reason: **an undocumented one** must say so
d2m3-a2.principle: **One dated document** per reason, or it's marked “account only”
checks: Escalation quoted exactly: **“onset at MVA 02/06/2026”**
Continuity: EMS report, call-outs, **06/19/2026 Causation Letter**
Disruption: **Dr. Reyes's 04/20 note**, 06/10 counseling summary
Social media checked; **nothing deleted or advised deleted**
dos: **One reason per row**, one dated document per reason
Keep **the work-product layer** in the CMS
donts: Documenting the 14-day gap and **forgetting the 19-day disruption**
Presenting **the client's word as documented**

questions: Name the **four reasons** for the 14-day gap and, beside each, its corroborating document and date.
Rewrite “Was it because you had no car?” **without suggesting the reason**. What does the leading version cost?
“Is this gap going to wreck my case?” Give **your exact answer**, then what you do next.
Fault is proved. What else must the file prove, with **which document**, and whose part is what?

d2m4-l1.hook: Most value is won or lost here: the demands spend only **what this audit proves**.
points: MMI is **a medical determination**; record it from the 06/12/2026 note
BI Specials are **medical plus wages**; the Civic runs separately
Show **billed beside paid**; which one to claim is Atty. Thorne's call
Future care ($3,400–$6,800) stays **out of the audited total**
d2m4-l1.upl: You audit and flag; valuing, billed-or-paid and the demand figure are Atty. Thorne's.
dos: **Stress-test the file** before the defense does
Identify **every lien before the demand**
Record **the source of every figure**
donts: Sending the demand and **hoping nobody checks**
**Adding future care** to the Specials
Discovering a lien **after the release** is signed

ruleEx.rule: Specials are **incurred, documented economic losses**: $14,817.40 medical, $16,401.40 with wages
ruleEx.exception: Future medical ($3,400–$6,800, possible repeat ESIs) is real but not incurred: **narrative, never the total**
ruleEx.confirm: Atty. Thorne decides billed versus paid

redFlag.see: A Riverton ledger line, **05/04/2026**, that no visit note supports
redFlag.costs: Claiming it inflates the Specials and gives Keystone a reason to doubt the ledger
redFlag.do: Remove it; **send the billing correction** to the provider in writing

d2m4-a1.situation: Early July 2026, after MMI 06/12/2026. Medical Bills **total $15,002.40**; Riverton Spine & Rehab bills **34 lines × $185.00**; Northgate verifies 9 missed shifts at 8 h × $22.00.
steps: In CMS → Financial Ledger → Specials, enter each provider's charges with dates, amount billed and who paid.
Check Riverton Spine & Rehab's lines against its visit notes and remove any line no visit supports. Use the Amendment Requests below.
Total the medical, add the verified wages, show billed beside paid, and put future care in the narrative, not the ledger.
List every lien, re-check the three policy limits in order, and **flag for Atty. Thorne** anything that is his to decide.
d2m4-a1.deliver: An **audited ledger at $16,401.40**, billed beside paid, liens, targets, flags routed
d2m4-a1.purpose: One unproved line hands the defense **a reason to doubt** every figure
d2m4-a1.principle: **Audit, don't total**: every line needs its visit or source
checks: **Five pre-treatment shifts flagged**, with Northgate's Attendance Record
Billed-vs-paid choice **routed to Atty. Thorne**
**Liens listed**: Peach State $1,860.00, LOP $6,105.00
dos: **Count the visits** before adding a provider's lines
Keep the **duplicate's removal visible**
donts: **Totaling the statement** instead of auditing it
Dropping **the paid column** because it shrinks the number

d2m4-l2.hook: Atty. Thorne decides from your brief: lead with **the decision, not the chronology**.
points: **Bottom line first**: where the file stands, what you need
Facts next, **audited and sourced**; the trinity must agree
Name each risk **with its answering document**, or say none
Frame decisions as **questions only he can answer**
d2m4-l2.upl: Recommend on operations only; the demand, billed-or-paid and the UM timing are Atty. Thorne's.
dos: Bring **the bad facts** yourself
Find **discrepancies before the defense** does
Check **public social media**; never suggest deleting
donts: A summary memo that **runs to three pages**
An exhibit index whose **page numbers don't match**
Briefing **the initial PD estimate**, not the final figure

redFlag.see: You're asked **'What's it worth?'** and reach for a number
redFlag.costs: Value is Atty. Thorne's call, and a Case Manager's figure can anchor the demand
redFlag.do: Answer with inputs: **Specials, limits, liens**. Never a number

d2m4-a2.situation: Early July 2026, before any demand. Your audit: MMI 06/12/2026, **Specials $16,401.40**, liens $1,860.00 and $6,105.00, targets **$10,000 → $20,000 → $10,000**. Atty. Thorne has called the strategy session.
steps: Take the strategy session below. Brief Atty. Thorne in order: the **bottom line** first, then the audited facts, the risks, the decisions and the options.
Answer his challenges with facts from the file, not adjectives, and recommend only on operations.
Read back each decision he makes, then record it in CMS → Case Notes with a task for each and re-route the Case Plan.
